title: Didone Blob — Editorial Agency Portfolio
description: A white-ground editorial portfolio slide built around a giant Didone display serif and organic blob ornaments bleeding from corners. Sets itself apart by pairing classical typographic authority with a right-side UI mockup zone and a stark black CTA pill.
philosophy: This template exists for agencies that believe a portfolio should announce creative authority before it explains credentials. It leans on the Didone serif's historical gravitas to own the display moment, then earns product credibility through the embedded dashboard mockup — a pairing that flatters studios pitching to tech and product clients simultaneously. It refuses gradients, glassmorphism, and anything that blurs the ink-on-white discipline at its core. The organic blobs are the only expressive release, and they earn their place by staying at the periphery rather than competing with the type.
goodFor: Agency capability deck opening hero slides built around a single bold discipline word
UI/UX studio portfolios pitching to product and tech clients who need to see both visual taste and UX command
Slides pairing a high-impact display headline with a framed product screenshot or dashboard composition
Creative director or team intro slides requiring strong typographic authority without heavy decoration
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly business or financial review decks
Multi-column text-dense academic or research presentations
Presentations requiring a dark, branded-color, or non-white background system
Teams without access to a high-contrast Didone-class or hairline-bracketed display serif
author: harness

examples.promptCore: An authoritative hero that announces creative identity through a single colossal display word — ink-on-white, zero visual softening. Composition is asymmetric: dense typographic mass dominates the left field while open white space breathes on the right, anchored only by organic blobs bleeding from opposing corners as peripheral pressure points rather than decoration. The overall feel is a prestige editorial masthead adapted for a pitch room — classical typographic rigidity held in deliberate tension with the blobs' loose, almost biological edges. Avoid centered symmetry, any layered transparency, gradient washes, or decorative elements that compete with the display type's gravitational pull.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; the display headline occupies cols 1–7 in a stacked two-line lockup flush left, commanding the upper-center zone. Organic blob ornaments bleed from the top-left and bottom-right corners, remaining fully outside the active type column. An agency subhead or discipline descriptor sits one leading increment below the headline, constrained to cols 1–5. A stark pill CTA anchors near the bottom of the type column, with a slim deck-identity label at the far-right margin as a quiet counterweight.

examples.promptCore: The slide carries the discipline of a luxury editorial spread: ink-on-white clarity, where every element earns its place through restraint rather than decoration. The left column owns typographic authority — a single large display statement above a hairline rule, then modular content cells below that feel like a well-set magazine sidebar. The right mockup frame acts as proof of craft, cool and precise against the expressive warmth of the blob ornament barely visible at the periphery. Avoid any softness, blurring, gradient washes, or decorative fills; the tension between the serif's historical weight and the product artifact's modernity is the entire visual argument.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid; content occupies cols 1–7 with a generous outer margin (~8%) and breathing internal padding — display headline anchors the upper third, followed by a tight rule line, then 2–4 supporting items (stat callout, short descriptor pair, or feature tags) stacked with deliberate white-space between each. A single organic blob bleeds from the top-right or bottom-left corner at low opacity, never overlapping the mockup frame. Page number anchors bottom-right at caption scale.
